(oṃ)༄༅/ /edhi/nā ro mkha' spyod kyi tshogs mchod 'phags pa rin po ches mdzad pa bzhugs so/ /༈/dpal rdo rje rnal 'byor ma'i tshogs kyi 'khor lo'

tei:div.tei:p: (oṃ)༄༅// edhi/ nā ro mkha' spyod kyi tshogs mchod 'phags pa rin po ches mdzad pa bzhugs so// ༈ /dpal rdo rje rnal 'byor ma'i tshogs kyi 'khor lo'i cho ga bla ma dang dpal rdo rje rnal 'byor ma la phyag 'tshal lo// rgyal ba kun gyi ye shes kyi// sgyu ma'i rnam 'phrul las byung ba// mkha' spyod ma dpal la btud de// de mnyes byed pa'i cho ga bshad// dam tshig dang ldan pa 'dir zhugs shing*/ rnal 'byor la gnas pa'i gang zag gis/ khyad par du 'phags pa'i dus kyi tshe/ dben zhing yid du 'ong ba'i gnas su/ mchod pa dang gtor ma gsum dang*/ yo byad rnams bsags nas/ dmar gtor gcig oṃ āḥhūm̐ gi bdud rtsir byin gyis rlabs la/ na maḥsarba ta thā ga ta bh+yo bi shwa mu ṣe bh+ya sarba tha khaṃ ut+ga te s+pha ra ṇa i maṃ ga ga na khaṃ gṝh+ne daṃ ba liṃ ta swā hā/ zhes lan gsum brjod de bgegs rnams la sbyin nas/ bgegs dang 'byung po'i tshogs thams cad mchod sbyin gyi gtor ma rgya chen po 'dis tshim par gyis la/ de bzhin gshegs pa la mchod pa'i las brtsams pa la/ bar du gcod pa ma byed par gzhan du dengs shig ces pa dang*/ sum+bha ni brjod cing*/ rol mo'i sgra dang bcas pas bskrad do// de nas las kyi slob mas zhu ba phul ba dang*/ rang skad cig gis rdo rje rnal 'byor mar dmigs nas/ lag pa g.yon pa'i se gol shar phyogs nas g.yon skor dang*/ shar lho nas mtshams g.yas skor du gdab cing*/ sum+bha ni sngags rkang pa re re brjod pas bgegs bskrad do// de nas nang mchod gtor ma ltar byin gyis brlabs nas lag pa g.yon pa'i mtheb srin gyis g.yon skor du chos 'byung nyis brtsegs bri zhing*/ 'di'i oṃ gsum ma'i sngags brjod pas ye shes kyi bdud rtsi'i rgya mtshor byin gyis rlabs/ de nas byin gyis rlabs pa'i bdud rtsi des lag pa g.yas g.yon phan tshun gtor zhing mnye ba dang*/ dpral ba/

mgrin pa/ snying kha gsum du thig le bkod pas rang gi lus dag par byas nas/ gnas dang phyi'i mchod pa rnams la gtor te/ lha rdzas las grub pa'i gzhal yas khang dang*/ mchod pa rgya chen po dwangs shing thogs pa med pa dang bcas par dmigs nas/ oṃ āḥhūm̐/ zhes brjod/ de nas rdo rje sems dpa'i rnal 'byor dang ldan pa'i yi ge brgya pa brjod pas sdig pa sbyangs nas/ sgrub thabs nas 'byung ba bzhin mngon par rtogs pa bsgom ste/ bzlas pa ci rigs pa bya'o// de nas yang nang mchod kyis mchod rdzas rnams la gtor zhing*/ sum+bha nis bsang*/ swa bhā was sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las oṃ āḥhūm̐ las mchod yon la sogs pa lha rdzas las grub pa'i mchod pa dpag tu med par bskyed nas/ so so'i sngags dang*/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ gis byin gyis rlobs/ de nas mdun du dmigs pa'i rten yod dam/ med kyang rung ste/ skad cig gis rdo rje rnal 'byor ma rang gis bsgom pa lta bur bskyed nas/ dpa' mo'i go cha drug bkod de/ ye shes pa spyan drangs nas bstim pa'i bar bdag bskyed ltar byas nas/ de'i mtha' mar rtsa ba dang brgyud par bcas pa'i bla ma rnams dang*/ sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' dang dpa' bo rnal 'byor ma dang chos skyong ba'i srung ma thams cad kyis gang bar bsgoms nas/ de rnams la mchod par bsam zhing*/ so so'i phyag rgya dang bcas pas/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta badz+ra yo gi ni zhes kun la sbyar la ar+ghaṃ pra tīts+tsha ye swā hā yis mchod yon/ pā d+yaṃ pra tīts+tsha ye swā hā yis zhabs bsil/ badz+ra puṣ+pe āḥhūm̐ gis me tog oṃ badz+ra dhu pe āḥhūm̐ gis bdug spos/ badz+ra a lo ke āḥhūm̐ gis mar me/ badz+ra gan+dhe āḥhūm̐ gis dri chab/ badz+ra nai wi d+ye āḥhūm̐ gis zhal zas/ badz+ra shāb+da āḥhūm̐ gis rol mo 'bul/ de nas dngos su 'byor pa dang yid kyis sprul pa'i 'dod yon lngas mchod par bsam zhing*/

rū pa kā ma gu ṇa badz+ra pū dzi te āḥhūm̐ gis gzugs/ shāb+da kā ma gu ṇa badz+ra pū dzi te āḥhūm̐ gis sgra/ gan+dhe kā ma gu ṇa badz+ra pū dzi te āḥhūm̐ gis dri/ rā sa kā ma gu ṇa pū dzi te āḥhūm̐ gis ro/ spar+ṣe kā ma gu na badz+ra pū dzi te āḥhūm̐ gis reg bya 'bul bar bya'o// de nas nang gi mchod pa'i thog mar rtsa ba'i bla ma la 'bul/ de nas bla ma brgyud pa rnams la 'bul te/ rdo rje 'chang*/ rdo rje rnal 'byor ma/ rdo rje dril bu pa/ ḍaiṃ gi pa/ an tar pa/ tai lo pa/ nā ro pa/ pham thing pa/ bla ma mal/ bla ma sa skya pa chen po/ slob dpon rin po che/ rje btsun rin po che/ bla ma chos kyi rje zhes pa'i mtshan rnams kyi mthar oṃ āḥhūm̐ zhes brjod cing dbul/ de rnams rdo rje rnal 'byor ma la mchod nas/ rang gi lce rtse/ dpral ba/ mgrin pa/ snying ga rnams su reg pas rang gi lus kyi lha thams cad mchod de/ chos skyong srung ma dang*/ yul nyi shu rtsa bzhi'i dpa' bo dang rnal 'byor ma dang*/ 'gro ba rigs drug gi sems can rnams la byin no// de nas rang gi lce la reg pas bdag bskyed dang mdun bskyed kyi dkyil 'khor gyi lha rnams mnyes nas/ bzhad pa'i dbyangs sngags kyi sgrar grags par bsam zhing*/ de nyid kyi sngags lan gsum brjod do// de nas dpral bar nam mkha' mdzod kyi phyag rgya bcas nas/ na mo chos kyi dbyings kyi byin rlabs dang*/ sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad kyi thugs rje rnam par dag pa'i byin rlabs dang*/ sngags dang phyag rgya'i mthu dang*/ bdag gi mos pa dang*/ ting nge 'dzin dang*/ smon lam gyi dbang gis 'jig rten gyi khams na bdag pos yongs su ma bzung ba'i mchod pa'i bye brag ji snyed yod pa dang*/ gzhan yang byang chub sems dpa' kun tu bzang po'i rnam par thar pa las byung ba'i mchod pa'i sprin gyi phung po lta bu bsam gyis mi khyab pa/

bla ma dang*/ rdo rje rnal 'byor ma dang*/ sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad kyi spyan sngar 'byung zhing rgyas par gyur cig ces brjod nas se gol gdab bo// yang snying gar phyag rgya bcas la/ oṃ sarba bid pu ra pu ra/ su ra su ra/ a warta ya a warta ya ho/ namaḥs man+ta bud+dha naṃ a bhi sma ra ye/ s+pha ra na i maṃ/ ga ga na khaṃ/ dharmā dhā tu/ a kar+sha ya/ sa man+ta maṃ/ sarba ta thā ga ta a pa ri shwa dha ye/ maṇ+ḍa la/ ma ma pra ni te/ pu ṇ+ya dzñā na wa le na/ sarba ta thā ga ta/ ba len dha/ ban dha swa sa thā na/ ba len na tsa ye swā hā/ zhes brjod nas/ bdag pos ma bzung ba dang yid las byung ba'i mchod pas mchod par bya'o// de nas dpal ldan rdo rje mkha' 'gro ma la sogs pas bstod par bya'o//

de nas gtor ma sbyangs sgrub thabs las 'byung ba'i cho gas dang po rdo rje rnal 'byor ma dang*/ gnyis pa chos skyong dang*/ gsum pa mkha' 'gro spyi gtor gyis 'bul bar bya'o/ /de nas tshogs kyi yo byad rnams gtor ma ltar byin gyis rlabs nas/ tshogs kyi phud bla ma dang lha rnams la dbul zhing*/ gtor ma la'ang so so'i sngags brjod pas phul nas/ dam tshig drangs la phud nang mchod kyi skabs ltar phul nas/ lag pa'i mchod pa byas la/ kha zas kyi rnal 'byor dang ldan pas/ g.yon gyi kun tu spyod pa'i tshul gyis zhen pa med cing*/ tshim par longs spyod/ bar skabs su phyi nang gi lha mchod pa'i bsam pas/ g.yeng bar mi 'gyur ba'i glu dang gar dang rol mo'i sgras mchod par bya'o// dus thams cad du bdag dang snang ba thams cad rje btsun rdo rje rnal 'byor ma'i sku dang*/ rang gi brjod pa dang*/ phyi rol du grags pa thams cad rnal 'byor ma'i sngags dang*/ sems kyi bsam pa thams cad ye shes kyi cho 'phrul du dmigs la/ phyi nang gi nyams myong bde ba thams cad kyis rdo rje rnal 'byor ma la mchod par bsam zhing*/ yang yang du lha'i rnam par gsal btab par bya'o// de nas longs spyod pas tshim pa dang*/ lhag ma rnams bsdus pa la 'bar ba'i phyag rgya'i nang la chang gi kha phru btab la/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ gis bdud rtsi'i rgya mtshor byin gyis rlabs la/ oṃ kha kha/ khā hi khā hi/ u tsiṣ+ṭha ba liṃ ta bhak+ṣa si swā hā/ zhes gsum gyis byin nas rdo rje'i glu blangs la/ bkra shis gang zhig chos kyi dbyings las 'byung 'gyur zhing*// he ru ka dpal 'jigs byed rgyal po 'bar ba'i sku// shes rab phag mo'i pad+mar las ni rdo rje rol mdzad pa// bkra shis des ni bde ba mchog la gnas pa'i bkra shis shog /ces brjod nas mdun bskyed kyi lha la bdag gi sdig pa dang*/ sgrib pa dang*/ dam tshig gi nyes pa dang*/ bar du gcod pa dang*/

mi mthun pa'i phyogs thams cad zhi ba dang*/ tshe dang*/ dpal dang*/ 'byor pa dang*/ sku gsung thugs kyi dngos grub ma lus pa stsal du gsol/ 'chi ba'i tshe mkha' la spyod pa'i gnas su 'khrid pa dang*/ mthar thug bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas rdo rje 'chang chen po'i go 'phang thob par mdzad du gsol/ zhes lan gsum gsol ba btab nas/ lha mo tshad ma la sogs bden pa'i stobs kyang lan gsum brjod nas/ sems can thams cad bde gyur cig /sems can thams cad skyon med par// gang gis lam gyis grol gyur pa// des ni sangs rgyas nyid thob shog /ces pa la sogs pa'i smon lam btab nas/ ma 'byor pa dang nyams pa dang*// gang yang bdag rmongs blo yis ni// bgyid pa dang ni bgyid stsal ba// de kun mgon pos bzod par gsol// zhes bzod par gsol lo// de nas mdun bskyed kyi rten yod na gshegs gsol mi dgos la/ med na gtor ma'i mgron dang bcas pa la/ oṃ khyed kyi sems can don kun mdzod// rjes su mthun pa'i dngos grub stsol// sangs rgyas yul du gshegs nas kyang*// slar yang 'byon par mdzad du gsol// zhes dang*/ yi ge brgya pa'i mthar badz+ra muḥ zhes brjod pas ye shes pa gshegs su gsol/ dam tshig pa bdag la bsdu/ gtor ma rol mo'i sgra dang bcas pas bskyal nas/ rang gi gnas gsum bsrung zhing*/ go cha drug gis kyang rgyas btab la nyal ba'am/ spyod lam gyi rnal 'byor gyis chos chos bzhin du gnas par bya'o// de ltar rgyun du rnal 'byor du byed pa ni sdig pa dang*/ dam tshig gi nyes pa 'dag pa dang*/ lha dang bla ma'i thugs dam bskang zhing bsod nams dang ye shes kyi tshogs myur du rdzogs par 'gyur ro// chos tshul 'di ni 'phags pa yis// bsdebs nas go go can la 'bul// dge ba 'di yis 'gro ba kun// tshogs gnyis dpal gyis 'byor gyur cig /dpal ldan rdo rje mkha' 'gro ma'i tshogs kyi 'khor lo'i cho ga'i rim pa 'di ni/

dad pa dang shes rab dang ldan pa go go can zhes bya bas bskul nas/ chos kyi rje sa skya pa'i gsung bzhin du/ lcags pho rta'i lo gdu bu'i zla ba'i tshes gcig la shangs mdor bris pa'o// ༈ / mkha' spyod gsang ba'i sgo 'byed zhes bya ba bzhugs so// ༈ /na mo badz+ra yo gi ni/ thugs rjes 'gro la rjes chags mdzes pa'i sku// gang gis bsgom zhing gsang sngags tshogs bzlas pa'i// sgrub po mkha' spyod gnas su 'khrid mdzad ma// yi dam lha mo de la bdag skyabs mchi// bskyed rim rnal 'byor bcu gcig bsgom tshul dang*// tshes bcu'i sbyin sreg mar me'i sbyin sreg rnams// dad ldan slob mas gsol ba btab pa'i ngor// dam pa'i gsung bzhin gsal bar bri bar bya// rje btsun nā ro ta pas gzhan la mi gnang ba'i man ngag pham thing pa sku mched nas brgyud pa'i rje btsun rdo rje rnal 'byor ma'i bsgom bzlas 'di la dpal sa skya pa chen po'i zhal nas rnal 'byor bcu gcig gis bsdus par gsungs te/ nyal dang ldang dang bdud rtsi myong*// tshad med bla ma bdag lhar bskyed// 'gro ba dag pa'i rnal 'byor dang*// dpa' bo dpa' mos byin gyis brlabs// ngag bzlas yid bzlas gnyis gcig yin// bsam gyis mi khyab rnal 'byor dang*// spyod lam gyi ni rnal 'byor te// de ltar rnal 'byor bcu gcig go /zhes so// de la dang po nyal ba'i rnal 'byor ni/ srod thun la bsgom bzlas byas na/ thun gzhug tu bsam gyis mi khyab pa'i rnal 'byor bsgom pa'i ngang la nyal/ ma bsgoms na skad cig gis stong pa nyid du bsgoms pa'i ngang la nyal/ bskyed rim la mos pa che na/ rin po che'i khri'i steng du rje btsun ma sha rus sogs gdos bcas ma yin par 'od kyi rang bzhin du bsgoms pa'i spyi bor bla ma bzhugs par bsams nas/ de la phyag 'tshal bar bsgom ste nyal bar man ngag kha cig las 'byung bas/ de yang legs pa yin no// gnyis pa ldang ba'i rnal 'byor ni/

nam mkhar ḍā ma ru'i sgra nye ba'i snying por grags pa tsam gyis bskul nas/ rje btsun ma phyag mtshan med pa'i skur ldang bar bya'o// las dang po pas gnyid kyi ngang du de dran pa mi yong na'ang gnyid sad ma thag tu des bskul nas ldang ba yin no snyam du mos pa byas pas/ goms nas gnyid sad khar de dran pa 'byung ngo*// gsum pa bdud rtsi myang ba ni/ bdud rtsi ril bu yod na snying ga'i bam̐ yig mchod pa'i bsam pas 'bru gsum brjod cing myang ngo*// med na chang bdud rtsir byin gyis brlabs pa hub gsum 'thung ngo*// bzhi pa tshad med bsgom pa ni/ thog mar skyabs su 'gro ba gsum la sogs pa byas nas/ bdag gis rdzogs pa'i byang chub kyi go 'phang thob par byas la/ sems can thams cad srid pa'i sdug bsngal gyi rgya mtsho las bsgral bar bya/ de'i ched du bdag gis lam zab mo bsgom par bgyi'o// zhes lan gsum brjod cing bsam ste/ de la tshad med pa bzhi tshang gsungs so// lnga pa bla ma'i rnal 'byor ni/ mdun gyi nam mkhar seṅges btegs pa'i rin po che'i khri sna tshogs pad+ma dang zla ba'i gdan gyi steng du rtsa ba'i bla ma rje btsun rdo rje chos kyi rnam pa can/ sku mdog dmar mo zhal gcig phyag gnyis kyi g.yas pas bde stong gi sgra sgrogs pa'i ḍā ma ru 'khrol ba/ g.yon pas thod pa bdud rtsis gang ba thugs kar 'dzin cing g.yon pa'i gru mo na kha ṭ+wāṃ ga bsnams pa/ zhabs rdo rje'i skyil krung gis bzhugs pa/ sku la rus pa'i rgyan drug gis brgyan cing gzhon nu lang tsho dar la babs pa'i sku can zhes brjod cing bsam la/ dus gsum sangs rgyas thams cad kyi ngo bo bla ma dang rnal 'byor ma gnyis su med pa la bdag phyag 'tshal zhing skyabs su mchi'o// byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ zhes lan bdun gsol ba btab ste/ bla ma 'od du zhu nas rang gi smin mtshams nas thim par bsam mo// drug pa bdag lhar bskyed pa ni/

rang gi snying gar e e las chos kyi 'byung gnas gru gsum nyis brtsegs kyi nang du a las zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi dbus su bam̐ yig dmar po'i mtha' mar g.yon skor du/ oṃ oṃ oṃ/ sarba bhud+dhā ḍā ki nī ye/ badz+ra war+ṇa nī ye/ badz+ra bai ro tsa nī ye/ hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa phaṭa phaṭa swā hā/ zhes pa'i sngags kyis bskor ba las 'od zer byung bas lus kyi phyi nang thams cad gang ste/ lus ngag yid gsum gyi sdig sgrib thams cad dag pas lus 'od kyi gong bur gyur/ de yongs su gyur pa las/ rang nyid rje btsun rdo rje rnal 'byor ma pad+ma dang nyi ma'i gdan la zhabs g.yas brkyang bas dus mtshan ma dmar mo dang*/ g.yon bskum pas 'jigs byed nag po mnan pa/ sku mdog dmar mo zhal gcig phyag gnyis spyan gsum ma/ phyag g.yas pas rdo rjes mtshan pa'i gri gug thur du 'phyang zhing g.yon pas thod pa khrag gis gang ba steng gi phyogs su bzung nas zhal gyen du phyogs pas gsol ba/ phrag pa g.yon par rdo rjes mtshan pa'i kha ṭ+wāṃ ga la dril bu dang*/ ḍā ma ru dang*/ 'phan rtse gsum pa 'phyang bzhin pa bsnams pa/ dbu skra nag po sil bur gyur pa/ mi mgo skam po lngas dbu brgyan cing*/ skam po lnga bcu'i do shal can/ rus pa'i rgyan lngas brgyan pa/ ye shes kyi me 'bar ba'i dbus na bzhugs par bsams la/ de'i gnas rnams su zla ba'i dkyil 'khor re re'i steng du/ lte bar oṃ bam̐ dmar mo rdo rje phag mo/ snying gar haṃ yoṃ sngon mo gshin rje ma/ khar hriṃḥmoṃ dkar mo rmongs byed ma/ spyi bor hriṃ hriṃ ser mo skyod byed ma/ spyi gtsug tu hūm̐ hūm̐ ljang gu skrag byed ma/ yan lag thams cad phaṭa phaṭaḥdud kha tsaṇ+ḍi ka te/ de dpa' mo'i go cha tsam dgod par bya'o// bdun pa 'gro ba dag par bya ba ni/ yang snying ga'i sngags phreng rnams las 'od zer byung ste/ ba spu'i bu ga nas song*/ rigs drug gi sems can rnams la phog pas/

de thams cad kyi lus ngag yid gsum gyi sgrib pa dag nas rje btsun rdo rje rnal 'byor ma'i skur gyur par bsam mo// brgyad pa dpa' bo dpa' mos byin gyis brlab pa ni/ lus kyis 'bar ba'i phyag rgya dpral ba'i dbyings su g.yon du lan gsum bskor/ ngag tu phaiṃ zhes brjod/ sems kyis snying ga'i bam̐ yig las 'od zer 'phros te/ 'og min nas rdo rje rnal 'byor ma la phyogs bcu'i dpa' bo dang rnal 'byor mas bskor ba dang*/ 'gro ba rnal 'byor mar bskyed pa thams cad kyang bdag gi ba spu'i bu ga nas thim par bsam zhing*/ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ zhes dang*/ pad skor gyi mthar 'khyud pa'i phyag rgya byas nas/ oṃ yo ga shud+dhaḥsarba dharmāḥyo ga shud+dho3haṃ/ zhes brjod do// dgu pa bzlas pa la gnyis las/ dang po ngag gi bzlas pa ni/ snying gar chos 'byung gru gsum nyis brtsegs kyi nang du zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi dbus su bam̐ yig dmar po la sngags kyi phreng bas g.yon skor du bkod pa las 'od zer 'phros/ sems can thams cad kyi sdig sgrib sbyong*/ sangs rgyas thams cad mchod/ de dag gi thugs ka nas thugs gnyis su med pa'i ye shes 'od zer dmar po'i rnam par spyan drangs/ snying ga'i sngags phreng rnams la thim pas rang gi rgyud byin gyis brlabs par bsams la/ oṃ oṃ oṃ/ sarba bud+dhā ḍā ki nī ye/ badz+ra war+ṇa nī ye/ badz+ra bai ro tsa nī ye/ hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐/ phaṭa phaṭa phaṭa swā hā/ zhes ci nus bzlas so// gnyis pa yid bzlas ni/ 'og rlung bskum steng rlung mnan te/ snying ga'i chos 'byung zla ba yig 'bru dang bcas pa bde ba skye bar 'dod na gsang gnas/ mi rtog pa skye bar 'dod na lte bar phab ste rlung kha sbyar nas/ grwa bzhir dga' ba 'khyil pa g.yon skor du 'khor ba dang yig 'bru rnams g.yon skor du 'khor bar dmigs te/ yid kyis lan bdun bzla'o// yid bzlas rdzogs rim mtshan bcas yin pas drod dang bde ba skye zhing 'phar g.yo drag tu 'byung la de byung na yang rim gyis glod/

du ba la sogs pa'i rtags thams cad 'di nyid las 'byung ngo*// bcu pa bsam gyis mi khyab pa'i rnal 'byor ni/ lte ba'i sngags phreng las 'od 'phros pas/ khams gsum thams cad 'od zer gyis gang*/ gzugs med khams thams cad 'od zer gyi rnam par byas nas lus kyi stod kyi cha la/ gzugs khams bar gyi cha la/ 'dod khams smad kyi cha la bsdu/ rang sku stod sku smad nas rim gyis bsdus te/ chos 'byung la/ de zla ba la/ de yig 'bru rnams la/ de bam̐ yig la/ de mgo bo la/ de zla tshes la/ de thig le la/ de nā da la/ de yang je phra je phrar mi dmigs te stong pa'i ngang las sems glod cing ci tsam gnas tshad du bzhag go /zhi gnas shas che na slar ldang*/ gsal ba dang bde shas che na stong par bzhag slar ldang ba ni sngar ltar rje btsun ma phyag mtshan med pa'i skur ldang ngo*// bcu gcig pa spyod lam gyi rnal 'byor ni/ de nas spyod lam la 'jug pa'i tshe/ rang dang snang ba thams cad rdo rje rnal 'byor ma'i skur dmigs la/ bya byed kyi tshe lha la lhas mchod par bsam pa sku'i dga' ba/ de yang sgyu ma lta bu dang bsam gyis mi khyab pa'i ngang las ma g.yos par dran par bya ba thugs kyi dga' ba/ sgra ci grags pa thams cad sngags su dran pa gsung gi dga' ba ste/ dga' ba gsum gyi ngang las bya ba thams cad bya'o// rnal 'byor bcu gcig bstan zin to// gnyis pa tshes bcu gnyis la sogs pa'i dus su tshogs mchod bya ba la mdor bsdus pa'i tshul dang*/ spros pa la dga' na rgyas par bya ba'i tshul gnyis las dang po la gnyis/ sngon 'gro dang*/ dngos gzhi'o// dang po la bzhi ste/ gnas/ dus/ bsham pa/ mchod rdzas so// dang po ni/ gnas khang phyag dar bya/ chag chag gdab/ bris sku la sogs pa'i rten rnams gnas ji ltar 'tshams par bzhugs su gsol/ gnyis pa ni/ tshogs bsags par 'dod na yar gyi tshes bcu/ sgrib pa dag par 'dod na mar gyi tshes bcu ni dus khyad par can yin la/

dus rgyun du'am nam spro ba'i dus su'ang bya'o// gsum pa ni/ maṇ+ḍal la tsan+dan dmar po brdar ba'i chus srin lag g.yon pas chos 'byung gru gsum nyis brtsegs g.yon skor du bri zhing*/ de'i nang thams cad tsan+dan dmar po'i chus byugs/ tsan+dan dmar po'i chu med na chang bdud rtsir byin gyis brlabs pas/ de ltar bya/ dbus su me tog tshom bu gcig bkod pa ras dmar po'i gzhi'i steng du bzhag kha bstan phyogs rnal 'byor pa rang nyid kyi 'dug sa dang gnas khang dang bstun pas chog mtha' gcig tu nges pa med do// bzhi pa ni/ rang gi g.yon maṇ+ḍal gyi g.yas su me tog bdug spos mar me gsum/ mdun nas brtsams te phar rim pa bzhin bshams/ rang gi g.yas maṇ+ḍal gyi g.yon du dri chab dang gtor ma dang lha bshos gsum yang mdun nas phar rim pa bzhin bshams/ mdun du chang phud dang tshogs kyi yo byad ci 'byor pa bshams/ rnal 'byor pa so so'i mdun du nang mchod rdo rje dril bu rnams bshams mo// gnyis pa ni du ma yod na las kyi slob mas maṇ+ḍal phul te/ lha'i rnal 'byor la gnas par gsol ba gdab/ de nas tshad med nas bzung ste bsam gyis mi khyab pa'i ngang las rje btsun ma phyag mtshan med pa'i skur langs pa'i bar sgrub thabs su bstan pa bzhin byas nas rang gi lte ba'i bam̐ yig las bam̐ yig cig chad de maṇ+ḍal gyi dbus su gnas pa yongs su gyur pa las rje btsun mar bskyed de/ zhal phyag gsal btab pa dang*/ go cha bgo ba dang*/ ye shes pa gzhug pa rnams sgrub thabs bzhin bya'o// de nas nang mchod sum+bhas bsangs/ swa bhā was stong par sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las yam̐ las rlung ram̐ las me'i steng du a las thod pa dkar po yangs shing rgya che ba'i nang du go ku da ha na las sha lnga bi ra shu ma mu las bdud rtsi lnga/ 'og gi rlung g.yos me sbar bas rdzas rnams khol bas 'od du zhu nas bdud rtsi'i rgya mtshor gyur bar bsams la/

g.yon pa'i mtheb srin sbyar bas chos 'byung g.yon skor du bri ste/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ hoḥzhes brjod pas byin gyis brlabs/ nang mchod des mchod rdzas rnams la gtor te/ sum+bhas bsangs/ swa bhā was sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las ye shes kyi ka pā la yangs shing rgya che ba rnams kyi nang du hūm̐ zhu ba las byung ba'i lha rdzas las grub pa'i me tog bdug spos mar me dri zhal zas/ gzhan yang rol mo la sogs pa'i mchod rdzas rnams dwangs shing thogs pa med par bsams la/ oṃ badz+ra puṣ+pe āḥhūm̐ zhes sogs kyi byin gyis brlabs/ 'bul ba'i tshe oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta shrī badz+ra yo gi ni sa pā ri wā ra zhes pa kun sbyar la/ oṃ badz+ra puṣ+pe āḥhūm̐ nas oṃ badz+ra shāb+da āḥhūm̐ gi bar gyis mchod/ dharmā ra ṇi tas rol mo bya'o// oṃ gsum ma'i rjes su 'bru gsum brjod pas nang mchod gtor/ de nas gtor ma nang mchod chu chang gis sbyangs nas sum+bhas bsangs/ swa bhā was sbyangs/ lag pa g.yas g.yon gnyis ka bstan pa dang bya khyung gi phyag rgya bca' ste oṃ āḥhūm̐ hoḥhaḥhoḥhrīḥs byin gyis rlabs/ phaiṃ gyi sgra dang 'bar ba'i phyag rgyas dur khrod brgyad po spyan drangs nas mdun bskyed kyi mtha' skor du 'khod par bsams la/ mkha' 'gro spyi gtor gyi sngags dang gsol btab kyis 'bul/ 'di la gtor ma gzhan med/ de nas mdun gyi tshogs rnams bdud rtsi ltar byin gyis brlabs phud snod gtsang ma'i nang du blugs la maṇ+ḍal gyi mdun du bzhag ste/ gang gi drin gyis bde chen nyid// zhes sogs tshigs bcad gcig gis bla ma la phyag 'tshal ba sngon du 'gro bas rje btsun ma'i sngags lan gsum gyis rje btsun ma la dbul/ yang gtor ma la cha gcig bzhag nas mkha' 'gro spyi gtor gyi sngags lan gsum gis 'jig rten pa la dbul/ de nas snying ga'i bam̐ yig mchod pa'i bsam pas nang gi sbyin sreg la btab nas rnal 'byor pa rnams tshim par bza'/

lhag ma bsdus te 'bar ba'i phyag rgya dpral pa dang pheṃ gyi sgras chang phal pa'i kha phru btab ste a kā ro lan gsum gyis phyi rol na gnas pa'i 'byung po la byin nas/ rdo rje'i glu dang bkra shis kyi tshigs bcad kyai rdo rje bzhin dang*/ 'chi tshe mgon dang dpa' bo ma tshogs kyis// zhes sogs dang*/ lha mo tshad ma dam tshig tshad ma dang*// zhes sogs kyis smon lam btab/ yi ge brgya pa lan gsum gyis lhag chad kha bskangs nas mdun bskyed kyi ye shes pa gshegs/ dam tshig pa rang la bsdus nas maṇ+ḍal dang mchod rdzas dman pa rnams bsdus te las kyi rjes mi mngon par bya'o// gnyis pa spros pa la dga' bas rgyas par bya ba'i tshul ni rten bshams pa'i skabs su sngar gyi maṇ+ḍal ji lta ba bzhin bshams pa'i steng du mañdzi la sogs pa bzhag nas/ de'i steng du me long la sin+dhu ra dar tshag la btsags la thig gdab pa la chos 'byung gru gsum nyis brtsegs bris pa'i dbus su bam̐ yig dang*/ de'i mthar shar nas brtsams te yi ge sum cu rtsa gnyis g.yon skor du mgo phyir bstan pa bri/ de'i tshul yang shar nas brtsams ste oṃ gsum g.yon skor du sarba dang*/ bud+dhā dang*/ ḍā ki dang*/ nī ye dang*/ badz+ra dang*/ war+ṇa dang*/ nī ye dang*/ badz+ra dang*/ bai ro dang*/ tsa nī ye rnams rim pa bzhin g.yon nas bskor ba yin gyi nang sel gyi yi ge re re bzhin g.yon nas bskor ba ni ma yin no// de yang shar drang por oṃ dang*/ byang drang por ḍā dang*/ nub drang por nī dang*/ lho drang por nī byung na ma 'khrul ba yin no// de nas hūm̐ gsum dang phaṭa gsum rim pa bzhin 'bri'o// 'og tu bdud rtsi dang ting lo rnams ni dam tshig gso ba'i bdag 'jug dang slob ma la byin rlabs byed pa'i tshe dgos pa yin gyi 'dir mi dgos so// mchod rdzas kyi skabs su maṇ+ḍal gyi shar lhor gnas srung gi me tog shar drang por mchod yon nas chu gnyis sngon du 'gro ba'i nyer spyod g.yon skor du bshams/

de'i mdun gyi shar phyogs su 'das pa'i gtor ma dang*/ chos skyong gi gtor ma dang*/ 'jig rten pa'i gtor ma gsum yang g.yon skor du bshams/ chang phud dang tshogs rdzas snga ma bzhin bshams/ de nas maṇ+ḍal zhu 'bul nas brtsams te cho ga gzhan thams cad snga ma dang 'dra ba la lha bskyed pa'i tshe sin+dhu ra'i dkyil 'khor la lha bskyed/ mchod pa byin rlabs dang*/ dbul ba'i tshe chu gnyis byin gyis brlabs dang*/ dbul ba bsnan/ phyi mchod kyi rjes su nang mchod kyi dbus nas mtheb srin gyis blangs te thog mar rtsa ba'i bla ma'i mtshan la 'bru gsum btags pa dang*/ de nas rdo rje 'chang*/ rdo rje rnal 'byor ma/ nā ro pa/ pham thing pa sku mched/ klog skya shes rab brtsegs/ mal gyo lo tsā ba/ sa skya pa chen po/ slob dpon rin po che bsod nams rtse mo/ rje btsun rin po che grags pa rgyal mtshan/ chos rje sa skya paṇ+ḍi ta/ 'gro ba'i mgon po chos rgyal 'phags pa/ zhang dkon mchog dpal/ na bza' brag phug pa/ bla ma dam pa bsod nams rgyal mtshan/ dpal ldan tshul khrims pa/ chos rje ye shes rgyal mtshan pa/ rje btsun kun dga' bzang po/ mus chen dkon mchog rgyal mtshan rnams kyi zhal du oṃ āḥhūm̐/ de nas rtsa sngags kyi rjes su 'bru gsum btags pas rje btsun ma la dbul/ de nas yi dam gzhan la 'bul ba sogs ma rgyud spyi dang mthun pas nang mchod rgyas par dbul lo// de nas dpal ldan rdo rje mkha' 'gro ma sogs sh+lau ka gnyis kyis bstod nas/ 'dod pa'i don la gsol ba btab bo// gtor ma byin rlabs snga ma bzhin byas nas/ dang po rje btsun ma'i sngags lan gsum dang a kā ro lan gsum gyis rje btsun ma la dbul/ chu gnyis sngon du 'gro ba'i nyer spyod kyis mchod/ nang mchod sngags kyi rjes su 'bru gsum gyis dbul/ bstod pa sngar bzhin no// gnyis pa rang gi chos skyong gang yin la 'bul/ gsum pa mkha' 'gro spyi gtor gyis 'jig rten pa la 'bul/

de nas gur nas 'byung ba'i rgyun bshags lan gsum dang*/ rigs lnga'i sdom bzung lan gsum dang*/ dam tshig nyi shu rtsa gnyis 'dzin pa lan gsum byas nas/ tshogs byin gyis brlabs pa man chad snga ma bzhin spyad par bya'o// tshes bcu la sogs pa'i tshogs kyi mchod pa bstan zin to// sngags kyi nus pa dbyung ba'i phyir/ sbyin sreg bya bar 'dod pas rgyas par bya ba'i tshul dang*/ bsdus te bya ba'i tshul gnyis las dang po ni/ zhi ba'i thab khung spyi dang mthun par thig gdab pa'i nang du chos 'byung gru gsum gnyis brtsegs kyi thig gdab/ chos 'byung gi ri mo rdul tshon dkar pos bcad/ nang thams cad rdul tshon dmar pos bkang ste/ mdun rgyab kyi grwa spangs pa'i grwa bzhir dga' ba 'khyil pa g.yon skor du bri/ dbus su nyi ma'i gdan la tshom bu dmar po bkod/ rang gi g.yon thab kyi g.yas su chu gnyis sngon du 'gro ba'i mchod pa lnga dang gtor ma gnyis bshams/ rang gi g.yas thab kyi g.yon du yam shing dang*/ mar khu dang*/ til nag po dang*/ zho dang*/ mar rtsam pa la sbyar ba'i zas mchog dang*/ ka ra/ bu ram sbrang rtsi gsum gyi ril bu dang*/ dūr+wa dang ku sha rnams bsham mo// rang nyid kha shar du bltas nas 'dug pa'i mdun du nang mchod rdo rje dril bu dgang blugs gzar dang bcas pa bzhag la/ bdag bskyed bsgom bzlas bsam gyis mi khyab pa'i ngang la rje btsun ma'i skur langs pa'i bar sgrub thabs bzhin bya'o// de nas thab dang mchod rdzas bsreg rdzas rnams la nang mchod nas gtor zhing*/ sum+bhas bsang*/ swa bhā was stong par sbyang pa'i ngang las hūm̐ las rin po che las grub pa'i thab khung yangs shing rgya che ba'i nang du bud shing brtsigs pa dang bcas dwangs shing thogs pa med par gyur/ hūm̐ zhes yang yang brjod pas byin gyis brlabs/ mchod rdzas dang bsreg rdzas rnams kyang oṃ āḥhūm̐ las byung ba'i mchod rdzas dang bsreg rdzas rnams dwang shing thogs pa med par bsams la/

oṃ āḥhūm̐/ zhes pa dang*/ so so'i sngags kyi byin gyis brlabs so// de nas/ oṃ badz+ra dz+wa la raṃ/ zhes pas me spar nas de'i dbus su pad+ma dkar po dang*/ zla ba'i steng du ram̐ las me lha ra skyes la zhon pa/ sku mdog dmar po zhal gcig phyag bzhi pa/ phyag g.yas kyi dang po mchog sbyin/ gnyis pas bgrang phreng*/ g.yon gyi dang pos dbyug gu rtse gsum pa/ gnyis pas gan+dhe 'dzin pa/ ral pa'i thor gtsug dang ldan zhing*/ tshangs pa'i skud pa dang*/ kṛṣ+ṇa sa ra'i lpags pas stod g.yogs dang*/ dar dmar po'i sham thabs can du bskyed pa'i gnas gsum du yi ge gsum bkod nas/ rang gi snying ga'i sa bon las 'od 'phros pas shar lho nas me lha spyan drangs par bsam zhing*/ oṃ ag+ne e h+ye hi zhes brjod nas/ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ gnyis su med par bstim/ yang 'od 'phros pas dbang gi lha rigs lnga spyan drangs/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyis 'di la mngon par dbang bskur ba stsal du gsol/ zhes gsol ba btab pas/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta a bhi ṣe ka ta sa ma shrī ye āḥhūm̐/ zhes gsungs shing dbang bskur dri ma dag chu lhag ma yar lud pa las rnam par snang mdzad kyis dbu brgyan par bsam mo// de'i ljags las 'od zer byung bas byon zan gsol bar bsam zhing*/ oṃ ag+na ye swā hā/ zhes brjod cing blugs gzar bdun gyis dgang gzar bkang ba lan gsum gyis byon zan dbul/ oṃ ag+na ye zhes pa kun la sbyar bas ar+ghaṃ nas shab+da'i bar gyis mchod/ oṃ ag+na ye/ oṃ āḥhūm̐/ zhes pas nang mchod 'bul/ 'jig rten dbang phyug tshangs dbang mgon gyi sras// me lha'i rgyal po ḍā ki'i dbang bskur ba// shes rab mchog gis nyon mongs thams cad bsreg /'jigs byed me lha nyid la mngon par 'dud// zhes pas bstod/ de nas/ oṃ ag+ne sarba pā paṃ shīn+taṃ ku ru ye swā hā/ zhes pa'i sngags 'di 'ba' zhig gis bsreg rdzas rnams lnga lnga'am bdun bdun tsam dbul/

slar yang sngar ltar mchod bstod byas nas/ oṃ ag+ne dz+wa la ram̐/ zhes pas me lha 'bar ba'i rnams par gyur par bsam mo// de nas 'bar ba'i dbus su rdo rje rnal 'byor ma bdag bskyed ci lta ba bzhin ye shes pa gzhug pa'i bar bskyed nas/ oṃ badz+ra yo gi ni/ zhes pa sbyar ba'i byon zan dang phyi mchod/ nang mchod rnams snga ma bzhin bya/ dpal ldan rdo rje mkha' 'gro ma// sogs sh+lau ka gnyis kyis bstod/ de nas rdzas rnams oṃ gsum ma'i swā hā'i gong du sarba pā pam̐ shīn+taṃ ku ru ye zhes pa la swā hā sbyar ba'i sngags 'di 'ba' zhig gis bsreg rdzas rnams brgya rtsa brgyad la sogs pa ci tsam nus pa dbul/ slar yang mchod bstod snga ma bzhin byas nas/ tshogs mchod kyi skabs su bstan pa ltar gtor ma yang dbul/ rje btsun rdo rje rnal 'byor mas bdag dang sems can thams cad kyi sdig pa dang sgrib pa thams cad byang zhing dag par byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ zhes 'dod pa'i don la gsol ba gdab/ yi ge brgya pa lan gsum dang*/ ma 'byor pa dang nyams pa dang*// sogs nongs pa bzod par gsol nas oṃ āḥhūm̐ badz+ra muḥ zhes pas ye shes pa gshegs dam tshig pa rang la bsdu bar bya'o// slar yang me'i nang du oṃ badz+ra dz+wa la ram̐/ zhes pas me lha gsal btab nas bsreg rdzas lhag ma rnams lan gsum phul nas sngar ltar mchod bstod byas te gtor ma mkha' 'gro spyi gtor ltar byin gyis brlabs pa/ oṃ ag+na ye na maḥsarba ta thā ga ta bh+yoḥ zhes pa lan gsum gyis phul/ oṃ ag+ne badz+ra muḥ zhes pa ye shes pa gshegs/ dam tshig pa bdag la bsdu'o// gnyis pa bsdus te bya ba'i tshul ni/ cho ga gzhan rnams snga ma dang 'dra ba las/ thab bri ba'i tshe re khā zlum po gnyis bskor gyi nang du/ chos 'byung nyis brtsegs snga ma bzhin bri/ gzhan thab rgyas pa mi dgos/ rang gi g.yas su bsregs rdzas mar khu dang*/ til 'ba' zhig bsham/ g.yon du mchod pa lnga dang gtor ma gcig bshams/

bdag bskyed dang thab dang rdzas rnams byin gyis brlabs pa snga ma bzhin du byas nas/ me sbar te/ 'jig rten pa'i me lha mi bskyed par rje btsun mar bskyed de/ phyi mchod nyer spyod lnga dang*/ nang mchod dang bstod pa rnams bya'o// phyi mchod kyi gong du byon zan snga ma ltar phul na yang rung zhing*/ ma phul na'ang nyes pa med do// de nas bsreg rdzas til 'ba' zhig sngar gyi sngags kyi ci nus dbul/ skabs skabs su mar gyis me gso/ mthar mchod bstod snga ma bzhin byas nas 'dod pa'i don la gsol ba gdab/ gtor ma mkha' 'gro spyi gtor gyis dbul/ me lha'am rje btsun ma'i zhabs kyi drung nas blang bar dmigs te/ lag pa g.yon pa'i srin lag gis sbyin sreg gi thal ba gcig blangs la rang gi mdzod spur bsku/ yang na dpral ba mgrin pa snying ga rnams su bsku'o// 'di ni bsrung ba'i mchog ste sngar gyi rgyas pa'i skabs su yang bya'o// de nas mdun bskyed kyi ye shes pa gshegs/ dam tshig pa rang la bsdu'o// bzhi pa rnal 'byor pa gang zhig mar me'i sbyin sreg byed par 'dod na/ mar me skong bu yangs par mar dkar kyi khu ba dang*/ ras dmar po'i sdong bu sbam po btsugs la me sbar/ 'byor na mchod pa lnga dang*/ gtor ma bshams/ rang nyid thun mtshams kyi rje btsun ma dran tsam gyis gsal btab ste/ mar me bdag bskyed kyi skabs ltar rje btsun mar bskyed/ mdun du til bzhag la/ bdag gi tshe thog ma med pa nas bsags pa'i las kyi sgrib pa thams cad sna sgor sdig pa rwa can gyi rnam par gyur nas mdun gyi til la thim par bsams la/ ngag tu oṃ badz+ra ḍā ka kha kha khā hi khā hi sarba pā paṃ shīn+taṃ ku ru ye swā hā/ zhes pas til bsreg mchod pa lnga dang gtor ma yod na/ oṃ badz+ra yo gi ni badz+ra puṣ+pe āḥhūm̐/ zhes sogs kyis dbul/ gtor ma mkha' 'gro spyi gtor gyi cho gas dbul lo// 'dis ni sdig pa thams cad dag pa dang*/

rje btsun ma'i byin rlabs 'jug pa'i thabs yin par gsungs so// gdams pa rgya mtsho gting mtha' mi dpog kyang*// dkon mchog rgyal mtshan gsung gi man ngag las// cung zad snyed 'dir kun dga' bde legs kyis// bskur ba'i ngor ni bsod nams seṅge sbyar// 'dir 'bad dge tshogs gang zhig thob pa des// bdag dang mkha' mnyam 'gro ba ma lus pa// rgyal ba'i yum mchog de yi rjes bzung nas// mkha' la spyod pa'i gnas su skye bar shog/ //maṅga laṃ// ༈

/edhi/ nā ro mkha' spyod kyi sbyin sreg 'phags pa rin po ches mdzad pa bzhugs so// ༈ /dpal rdo rje rnal 'byor ma'i sbyin sreg gi cho ga dpal rdo rje rnal 'byor ma la phyag 'tshal lo// bcom ldan 'das ma'i bsnyen pa sngon du song bas sngags kyi nus pa dbyung ba dang*/ mchog dang thun mong gi dngos grub bsgrub pa'i phyir/ sbyin sreg byed par 'dod pas sa'i cho ga byas pa'i sar mtshan nyid dang ldan pa'i thab khung du/ bud shing legs par brtsegs nas/ g.yon phyogs su chu gnyis sngon du 'gro ba'i mchod pa lnga dang*/ dmar gtor gsum bsham/ g.yas su yam shing*/ mar khu dang*/ chang bzang po la bdud rtsi sbyar ba dang*/ sha lnga tshang ba dang*/ gang yang rung ba'i dum bu gtubs pa dang*/ til dang*/ zho dang*/ 'o ma/ mar/ ka ra/ bu ram/ sbrang rtsi sbyar ba'i zas mchog dang*/ dūr+wa dang ku sha rnams bkod/ rang kha shar du bltas 'dug pa'i mdun du/ nang mchod rdo rje dril bu dgang blugs dang bcas pa bzhag nas/ bdag bskyed bzlas pa'i bar rdzogs par byas la/ thab dang*/ yo byad dang*/ mchod rdzas dang*/ bsreg rdzas rnams la nang mchod nas gtor zhing*/ sum+bha ni'i sngags kyis bsangs/ swa bhā was stong par sbyangs pa'i ngang las/ hūm̐ las rin po che las grub pa'i thab khung yangs shing rgya che ba'i nang du bud shing brtsigs pa dwangs shing thogs pa med par bskyed nas/ hūm̐ zhes yang yang brjod pas byin gyis rlabs/ mchod rdzas dang bsreg rdzas rnams oṃ āḥhūm̐ las lha rdzas las grub pa'i mchod rdzas bsreg rdzas dpag tu med par bskyed la/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ dang so so'i sngags kyis byin gyis rlobs/ oṃ ag+ne ye dz+wa la ram̐/ zhes brjod cing me sbar bas/ de'i dbus su ram̐ las me lha ra skyes kham pa la zhon pa/ sku mdog dmar po zhal gcig phyag bzhi pa/ g.yas kyi dang pos mchod sbyin/ gnyis pas bgrang phreng*/ g.yon gyi dang pos dbyu gu rtse gsum pa/

gnyis pas bdud rtsis gang ba'i ghan+dhe 'dzin pa/ ral pa'i thor tshugs dang ldan zhing tshangs pa'i skud pa dang khri snyan sa le'i pags pa'i stod g.yogs dang*/ dar dmar po'i sham thabs can/ me 'bar ba'i dbus na bzhugs pa'i dpral bar oṃ/ mgrin par āḥ thugs kar hūm̐ dmigs nas de'i thugs ka'i hūm̐ dang*/ rang gi snying ga'i sa bon las 'od 'phros pas/ shar lho nas me lha spyan drangs par bsam zhing*/ oṃ ag+na ye e h+ye hi/ zhes brjod nas/ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ mdun bskyed dang gnyis su med par bstim mo// de nas yang 'od 'phros pas/ sangs rgyas rigs lnga spyan drangs pa la mchod nas 'di la dbang bskur du gsol/ zhes gsol ba btab pas/ sangs rgyas rnams kyis/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta a bhi ṣe ka ta sa ma ya shrī ye hūm̐/ zhes gsungs shing*/ dbang bskur/ dri ma dag chu'i lhag ma yar lud pa las rnam par snang mdzad kyis dbu brgyan par bsam/ de nas de'i ljags las 'od zer byung ba'i nang nas byon zan gsol bar bsam zhing*/ oṃ ag+ne ye swā hā/ zhes brjod cing*/ lan bdun phul nas/ oṃ ag+na ye zhes kun la sbyar zhing*/ oṃ ar+ghaṃ pra tīts+tsha ye swā hā/ mchod yon nas zhal zas kyi bar du dbul la/ de nas 'bar ba'i me la yam shing*/ zhu ba'i rdzas rnams zhal dang*/ gong bu'i rdzas rnams phyag dang*/ dūr+wa dang ku sha spyi gtsug tu 'bul bar bsam zhing*/ gong gi sngags nyi shu rtsa gcig la sogs pas dbul/ bsreg rdzas rnams kyi mthar/ bdag gi sdig pa dang sgrib pa thams cad dang*/ nad dang bar du gcod pa thams cad shīn+taṃ ku ru ye swā hā/ zhes brjod do// slar yang mchod pa rnams kyis mchod nas/ oṃ ag+na ye dz+wa la ram̐/ zhes brjod pas me lha 'bar ba'i rnam par bsam mo// de nas 'bar ba'i dbus de nyid du rdo rje rnal 'byor ma bdag bskyed ji lta ba bzhin bskyed pa'i mtha' mar/ rtsa ba dang brgyud par bcas pa'i bla ma rnams dang*/

sangs rgyas dang*/ byang chub sems dpa' dang*/ dpa' bo dang*/ rnal 'byor ma rnams kyis bskor bar bsams la/ de rnams la snga ma bzhin 'di nyid kyi sngags kyis byon zan phul nas/ oṃ badz+ra yo gi ni zhes kun la sbyar ro// phyi'i mchod pa rnams kyis mchod nas/ nang bdud rtsis kyang mchod la/ dpal ldan rdo rje mkha' 'gro ma la sogs pas bstod par bya'o// de nas byin rlabs snga ma'i tshul gyis bdag nyid kyi sngags kyis dbul zhing*/ spel tshig rnams snga ma bzhin byas nas/ mthar yang dgang blugs bdun phul nas/ slar yang mchod pa dang bstod pa byas nas sgrub thabs bzhin gtor ma phul la/ 'dod pa'i don la gsol ba gdab bo// de nas yi ge brgya pa'i mthar badz+ra muḥ zhes brjod pas/ ye shes pa gshegs su gsol nas/ dam tshig pa bdag la bsdu'o// de nas me 'bar ba'i dbus su me lha dmigs pa la mchod cing bstod nas/ bsreg rdzas rnams rdzogs pa'i mthar mar dgang blugs bdun phul nas/ mchod pa dang bstod pa byas nas/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ gis ye shes kyi bdud rtsir byin gyis rlabs pa'i gtor ma/ oṃ ag+na ye na maḥsarba ta thā ga ta bh+yo bhi shwa mu khe bh+yaḥ sarba tha khaṃ ut+ga te s+pha ra ṇa i maṃ ga ga na khaṃ gṛh+ṇe daṃ ba liṃ ta ye swā hā/ zhes gsum mam bdun gyis dbul nas/ 'dod pa'i don la gsol ba gdab bo// gtor ma gsum pa mkha' 'gro spyi gtor gyis dbul lo// oṃ ag+na ye badz+ra muḥ zhes brjod pas ye shes pa gshegs la/ dam tshig pa bdag la bsdu'o// de nas tshogs kyi 'khor lo la longs spyod nas/ lhag ma'i bar cho ga rdzogs par byas la smon lam rgya chen po btab nas/ gnas gsum bsrungs te thal ba chu bo la sogs par dor la las kyi rjes mi mngon par byas nas/ spyod lam gyi rnal 'byor la gnas par bya'o// 'di ltar rtag tu byas na 'jig rten dang*/ 'jig rten las 'das pa'i dngos grub thams cad bde blag tu 'grub par 'gyur ro// rje sa skya pa'i man ngag

rdo rje rnal 'byor ma'i sbyin sreg gi cho ga 'di ni/ go go can gyis bskul nas 'phags pas sa mo sbrul gyi lor/ dbyar zla 'bring po la shangs mdor sbyar ba'o// //sarba maṅga laṃ// dge'o// dge'o/ dge'o// // ༈ bal yul mchod rten nye 'dabs nas rgyal yongs sa chen zhes pa las/ slob bu tha shal pa gu rus spel ba'o//
